goal: RestoreAssist E2E runs on E2E_PORT when set (default 3000): Playwright config, one local-origin helper, sketch-e2e NEXTAUTH_URL (UNI-3468)

criteria.text: config/playwright.config.ts serves and targets E2E_PORT when set and 3000 when not (webServer url and PORT env); PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL still wins and still disables the webServer
The changed E2E files take the local origin from e2e/helpers/local-origin.ts; none of them still hard-codes localhost:3000
criteria.recipe: git grep -n 'localhost:3000' -- config/playwright.config.ts e2e/helpers/session-cookie.ts e2e/pilot-workflow.spec.ts e2e/stripe-connect-payments.spec.ts e2e/setup-storage-google-drive.spec.ts; test $? -eq 1
